<!-- slot: abstract -->

We report registration accuracy across cyclic imaging rounds in a cohort characterised by
karyotype.

<!-- slot: introduction -->

Cyclic imaging acquires one panel per round, and nothing in the existing tooling holds those
panels in a common frame.

<!-- slot: methods -->

The pipeline runs as five stages, each reproducible from the committed configuration.

<!-- slot: methods-imaging -->

Donors were karyotyped before imaging. Twelve were 46,XX and one carried 47,XXX; the remainder
were 46,XY. Reporter lines expressing TK were imaged on the same instrument.

<!-- slot: methods-registration -->

Registration proceeds pairwise against the DAPI channel, which every round shares.

<!-- slot: results -->

Registration accuracy is sufficient for per-arm comparison, and it did not vary with karyotype.
